title: AI Panel Detection
description: Configure local AI panel detection and manage generated panel-flow data.

enable.title: Enable AI Panel Detection
enable.description: Turn AI-assisted comic panel detection on or off for the instance.

status.title: Status
status.description: Shows whether the AI service is reachable and ready.
status.dockerHint: This AI endpoint is configured for Docker networking. If Booklore is running outside Docker, point AI_SERVICE_BASE_URL to the host-mapped AI endpoint, for example http://localhost:18080.
status.startupPanelDescription: This panel auto-checks the AI service while it is starting and records the most recent startup events.
status.startupWaiting: Startup activity will appear here after the next status check.

prescan.title: Manual Panel Detection Scan
prescan.description: Scan selected library paths in the background and only generate AI panel data for comics that do not already have saved results.

cleanup.title: Generated Data Cleanup
cleanup.description: Delete all saved AI panel-flow records for your user account.
